Version, namespace, default namespace, boundary-space, default collation, base URI, construction, ordering, empty order, copy-namespaces, decimal-format and option declarations (output:* into serialization parameters); context value declaration; variable declarations (global initializers evaluated on first read, XQDY0054 cycles, external with defaults); function declarations (%public/%private, recursion, XQST0034); annotations (%updating rejected, ); item type and named record type declarations (4.0; records registered in the type registry). Done when prod-VarDecl, prod-VarDecl.external, prod-FunctionDecl, prod-Annotation, prod-ItemTypeDecl, prod-NamedRecordTypeDecl, prod-DecimalFormatDecl, prod-OptionDecl.serialization and the other prod-*Decl sets ≥ 90%. Spec: XQuery 4.0 "Modules and Prologs".
